_comment: Source of truth for job -> flow -> story. Rendered into README.md, PIPELINES.md and each workflow's MarkdownNote by scripts/gen_job_docs.py; gated by lint_docs.py.

stories.S1: Generate concept art from a prompt
stories.S2: Control composition from an existing image
stories.S3: Cut an object out, or mask it by description
stories.S5: Edit a picture: remove, replace, extend
stories.S7: Keep a character consistent across images
stories.S8: Transfer a style or a reference look
stories.S11: Materials: seamless textures, PBR, and into 3D
stories.S14: Move files to and from the box
stories.S15: Animate a character from a driving video
stories.S16: Get a pose from a photo
stories.S17: Recover a 3D motion clip from a video

jobs.want: Generate concept art from a prompt
Control composition from an existing image
Cut an object out (transparent PNG)
Mask by description ("the knight", "the roof")
Get a depth map
Inpaint / remove / add an object
Make the picture bigger (outpaint)
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/outpaint.json` (invents the new area; the original stays pixel-exact)

jobs.want: Extend a frame with its own content (not invented)
Fix a colour or tone cast across a result
jobs.detail: `scripts/color_match.py` (palette match; global cast only - see E20)

jobs.want: Relight / change the lighting
Compose a scene from parts (bg + character + prop)
Keep two subjects from merging
Keep a character consistent across images
Get a pose from a photo
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pose-extract.json` (a photo of a person -> the skeleton image a ControlNet reads, plus the keypoints JSON)

jobs.want: Put a character in a specific pose
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pose-extract.json` (get the pose from a photo) · `2d/workflows/qwen-edit-gguf.json` (instruction - best for a specific pose) · `2d/workflows/pose-skeleton.json` (skeleton cue - holds a **coarse stance** at `strength 1.5` + `end_percent 0.5`, but not limb angles)

jobs.want: Transfer a style or reference look
Turn one image into a multi-view turnaround
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/sv3d-turnaround.json` (SV3D_p; a 21-frame 360° orbit, no mesh needed — take frames 0/5/10/15 for 0/90/180/270)

jobs.want: Pixel art
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pixel-art.json` (from a prompt) · `pixel-art-convert.json` (existing image, faithful) · `pixel-art-restyle.json` (existing image, redrawn) · `scripts/atlas.py` (pack a sheet / slice one - local)

jobs.want: Build a sprite sheet / atlas
jobs.detail: `scripts/atlas.py` (pack images into a sheet / slice one back - local, `--verify` checks the round-trip)

jobs.want: Upscale / restore (incl. faces)
Upscale faithfully (GAN, invents nothing)
Make a texture tile seamlessly
Turn a texture into PBR maps
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pbr-material.json` (maps) -> `scripts/pack_pbr_material.py` (the packed map Unity needs) or `scripts/make_gltf_material.py` (glTF packing, optional GLB)

jobs.want: Push a 2D material into 3D
Make a 3D model from an image/description
Rig a character
Animate a sprite across a few poses
jobs.detail: `2d/workflows/pose-extract.json` (one pose per photo) -> `2d/workflows/pose-skeleton.json` (render each; keep the contrasts ~40 deg apart) -> `scripts/atlas.py` (pack the frames)

jobs.want: Sweep parameters into a labelled grid
jobs.detail: scripts/sweep_workflow.py (any shipped flow, any widget, 1-2 axes - image-conditioned flows included) · scripts/sweep.py (plain text-to-image, sampler axes) · scripts/sweep_outpaint.py (the outpaint seam specifically, with a boundary-step metric)

jobs.want: Move files to and from the box
Animate a character from a driving video
jobs.detail: `animation/workflows/wan-animate-motion.json` (a still character + a driving video you supply; the motion is transferred directly - no pose extraction or skeleton step) · `scripts/wan_segment.py` (clips longer than one pass - it segments the footage and joins the pieces)

jobs.want: Recover a 3D motion clip from a video
jobs.detail: `animation/workflows/sam3d-motion.json` (footage -> an animated skeletal GLB, for the engine to retarget) · `scripts/motion_quality.py` (gate the result: jitter and single-frame breaks)
